sources.title: Attain symbol data - historical tick data
facts: ProtoOAGetTickDataReq accepts symbolId, BID/ASK quote type, fromTimestamp and toTimestamp.
One historical tick request may not span more than 604800000 milliseconds (one week).
ProtoOAGetTickDataRes returns tickData and hasMore when the backend response is truncated.
Historical tick prices are raw tick values divided by 100000.

sources.title: Open API getting started / rate limits
facts: Historical requests are limited to 5 requests per second per connection.

sources.title: OpenApiModelMessages / ProtoOATickData and ProtoOAQuoteType
facts: Tick response ordering is newest first; first timestamp is absolute and later timestamps are backward differences.

sources.title: CY Costs and Charges Information & Examples, Version 2.0
facts: For cTrader and MetaTrader, commission on index markets is reflected in the spread with no separate commission charge.
The 2022 document publishes US500 and NAS100 time-of-day trading spreads and states spreads can vary with market conditions.
The document explicitly identifies DST applicability to index trading hours.

sources.title: Index trading fees and spreads
facts: Pepperstone currently states no commission is charged on index CFDs.
Current US500/NAS100 spread tables are recent-period statistics and are not retroactively used as historical spread paths.

sources.title: Index CFD trading
facts: Pepperstone describes current index pricing as sourced from multiple liquidity providers.
Pepperstone publishes current execution-speed/fill-rate marketing statistics; these are not historical latency guarantees.

non_promotion_rules: 2022 published spreads are contextual historical documentation, not a complete tick-level spread path.
Current averages/minima are not historical truth or upper bounds.
Current execution speed is not a historical slippage guarantee.
No numeric slippage bound is selected before candidate-independent quote evidence is acquired.
